additional_info.subject: Notes
additional_info.body:
Discussed the topic on 23.10 with Luca.
The request came due to a couple of events when, due to an overload of messages from the Backend to the SIM card inside router XF4, the router got somehow blocked. This caused that no messages from Backend could be received, for example in case of an attempted charging session.
The idea of the region was to set a P
ing Reboot inside the Teltonika router.
Ping Reboot is not used anymore and will be overwritten by the FW. Moreover,
th
e "EnsureOCPP connection" task will restart the PPP interface and the mobile modem, which is a feature embedded in the SICD FW, but not the router itself.
Because the events happened only few times during intense onsite testing sessions, with the region we agreed there is no need to proceed forward, with any eventual change of SIM card providers or change to RUT241 Teltonika HW.
Region will proceed by getting in touch with NOC's Head, to evaluate order of proactive monitoring service, for OCPP online/status status, and possible dashboards.
No further actions needed, as t
here is currently no concrete scenario in which these events could occur on the chargers in service
. Ticket can be closed
